purpose: Declared resolution of lane aliases, bare filenames and patch entrypoints to repository surfaces for MIGRATED_HISTORICAL records (sv_migration.resolve_surface). Only aliases verified against a real repository tree are resolved; aliases whose target exists only at another PR head are unresolved_declarations (FAIL_CLOSED, never ALLOW); anything else is UNKNOWN or NON_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE. The lifter refuses this file unless its git blob equals sv_migration.SURFACE_ALIASES_BLOB.
resolution_order: repository path in text (box-local -> NON_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE; outside every supplied tree -> NON_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE)
lane_aliases and unresolved_declarations (longest exact token; an unresolved declaration stays UNKNOWN and alias_disposition is its FAIL_CLOSED)
